description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related nested classes within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace. It provides interfaces and implementations for system identification, provisioning, internet, security, location, and time information, including methods for setting, getting, and updating system subsystem states and notifications.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class managing various system subsystems and notifications, providing interfaces to set, unset, retrieve, and update system information such as identifier, internet, location, time, provisioning, and security.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents the system identifier, managing device ID, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Provisioning
classes.description: Handles provisioning information, including storage labels.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Manages internet connectivity details such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Represents security information, primarily the callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Stores geographic location details including timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Set
methods.description: Sets a subsystem's information and triggers notifications if needed.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Unset
methods.description: Removes a subsystem's information and triggers notifications if needed.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current information object for a subsystem.

methods.name: SystemInfo::IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a subsystem is active.

methods.name: SystemInfo::BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Builds a hash representing the system info tree.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the system info.
